name: be 動詞現在式（am / is / are）
pattern: 主詞 + am / is / are + 名詞或形容詞
zh: be 動詞用來說明「某人／某物 是 什麼」或「處於什麼狀態」。I 配 am、你和複數配 are、單數第三人稱配 is。
points: I am（I'm）／ You are（You're）／ He, She, It is
We are ／ They are ／ 複數名詞 + are
否定：am not / is not (isn't) / are not (aren't)
問句：把 be 動詞移到句首 → Are you tired?

examples.en: I am a junior high school student.
examples.zh: 我是一個國中生。

examples.en: My brother is very tall.
examples.zh: 我的哥哥非常高。

examples.en: They are in the kitchen now.
examples.zh: 他們現在在廚房裡。

examples.en: Are you hungry? Yes, I am.
examples.zh: 你餓了嗎？是的，我餓了。

quiz.q: My sister ___ a nurse at a big hospital.
Tom and I ___ good friends.

name: 現在簡單式（一般動詞）
pattern: 主詞 + 動詞原形（第三人稱單數 + s / es）
zh: 現在簡單式用來說「習慣、每天做的事、事實」。主詞是 he / she / it 時，動詞要加 s 或 es。
points: I get up at six. → He gets up at six.（加 s）
watch → watches、go → goes、study → studies
否定：don't / doesn't + 動詞原形
問句：Do / Does + 主詞 + 動詞原形？

examples.en: I brush my teeth every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上刷牙。

examples.en: My mother cooks dinner for us.
examples.zh: 我媽媽為我們煮晚餐。

examples.en: He doesn't like coffee.
examples.zh: 他不喜歡咖啡。

examples.en: Does she walk to school? Yes, she does.
examples.zh: 她走路上學嗎？是的。

quiz.q: My father ___ the newspaper every morning.
___ your sister like ice cream?

name: 現在進行式
pattern: 主詞 + am / is / are + V-ing
zh: 現在進行式用來說「現在正在做的事」。用 be 動詞加上動詞 ing。常和 now（現在）、right now（此刻）一起用。
points: I am eating. / She is cooking. / They are talking.
ing 變化：make → making、run → running、swim → swimming
否定：is not V-ing / are not V-ing
問句：Is he sleeping? / What are you doing?

examples.en: I am eating breakfast right now.
examples.zh: 我現在正在吃早餐。

examples.en: Dad is making beef noodles in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 爸爸正在廚房煮牛肉麵。

examples.en: The students are having lunch together.
examples.zh: 學生們正在一起吃午餐。

examples.en: What are you cooking? It smells great!
examples.zh: 你在煮什麼？聞起來好香！

quiz.q: Look! The baby ___ right now.
We ___ dinner at a night market now.

name: 名詞複數與 There is / There are
pattern: There is + 單數 ／ There are + 複數名詞
zh: 「There is / There are」表示「有…」。單數或不可數用 There is，複數用 There are。名詞複數多加 s，也有特殊變化。
points: 複數：apple → apples、box → boxes、baby → babies
特殊：man → men、child → children、fish → fish
There is a cup on the table.（一個）
There are two eggs in the bowl.（兩個以上）

examples.en: There is a bowl of soup on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上有一碗湯。

examples.en: There are many restaurants near my home.
examples.zh: 我家附近有很多餐廳。

examples.en: There are three tomatoes in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡有三顆番茄。

examples.en: Is there a night market nearby? Yes, there is.
examples.zh: 附近有夜市嗎？有的。

quiz.q: There ___ many people in the restaurant.
There ___ a big cake on the table.

name: 過去簡單式（be 動詞與規則動詞）
pattern: 主詞 + was / were ／ 動詞 + ed
zh: 過去式用來說「已經發生的事」。be 動詞變成 was / were；規則動詞在字尾加 ed。常和 yesterday、last week 一起用。
points: am / is → was；are → were
規則變化：play → played、visit → visited、study → studied
否定：didn't + 動詞原形（didn't visited ✗）
問句：Did you + 動詞原形？ / Were you at home?

examples.en: The weather was sunny yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天天氣晴朗。

examples.en: We visited Taroko Gorge last summer.
examples.zh: 我們去年夏天遊覽了太魯閣。

examples.en: I stayed at a hotel near the beach.
examples.zh: 我住在海邊附近的旅館。

examples.en: Did you enjoy the trip? Yes, I did.
examples.zh: 你玩得開心嗎？是的。

quiz.q: It ___ rainy last night, so we stayed home.
They ___ their grandparents last weekend.

name: 過去簡單式（不規則動詞）
pattern: 主詞 + 不規則動詞過去式（go → went…）
zh: 很多常用動詞的過去式是「不規則變化」，不能加 ed，要一個一個記起來。
points: go → went、come → came、see → saw、eat → ate
have → had、take → took、buy → bought、get → got
make → made、ride → rode、swim → swam、fly → flew
否定和問句一樣用 did：Did you go...? / I didn't go.

examples.en: We went to Kenting by train.
examples.zh: 我們搭火車去墾丁。

examples.en: I saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨後我看到一道美麗的彩虹。

examples.en: She bought some gifts for her family.
examples.zh: 她買了一些禮物給家人。

examples.en: We ate seafood at the harbor last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在漁港吃海鮮。

quiz.q: Last Sunday, we ___ to the beach and swam.
He ___ a lot of photos on the trip.

name: 未來式（will / be going to）
pattern: 主詞 + will + 原形 ／ be going to + 原形
zh: 說「未來要做的事」用 will 或 be going to。be going to 比較常用在「已經計畫好」的事。
points: I will join the basketball team.（我會加入籃球隊）
She is going to run a marathon.（她打算跑馬拉松）
否定：won't（will not）／ isn't going to
問句：Will you...? / Are you going to...?

examples.en: I will exercise more this summer.
examples.zh: 這個暑假我會多運動。

examples.en: We are going to play badminton tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天要去打羽球。

examples.en: He won't give up the game.
examples.zh: 他不會放棄這場比賽。

examples.en: Are you going to join the swimming class?
examples.zh: 你要參加游泳課嗎？

quiz.q: I ___ play basketball with my cousin tomorrow.
She is ___ to run in the park this evening.

name: 助動詞 can / must / should
pattern: 主詞 + can / must / should + 動詞原形
zh: 助動詞後面一定接「動詞原形」。can 表示能力（會、可以）、must 表示必須、should 表示應該（建議）。
points: can：He can swim very fast.（能力）
must：You must wear a helmet.（規定、必須）
should：You should sleep early.（建議、應該）
否定：can't / mustn't / shouldn't + 原形

examples.en: I can ride a bike with no hands.
examples.zh: 我可以放開雙手騎腳踏車。

examples.en: You must drink enough water after exercise.
examples.zh: 運動後你必須喝足夠的水。

examples.en: You should stretch before you run.
examples.zh: 跑步前你應該先伸展。

examples.en: We shouldn't eat too much fast food.
examples.zh: 我們不應該吃太多速食。

quiz.q: You look tired. You ___ take a rest.
My little sister can ___ very well.

name: 形容詞比較級
pattern: A + be 動詞 + 比較級 + than + B
zh: 比較兩個人事物用「比較級 + than」。短的形容詞加 er，長的形容詞前面加 more。
points: tall → taller、big → bigger、easy → easier
長形容詞：more beautiful、more difficult
不規則：good → better、bad → worse
Math is more difficult than English.（比較長的形容詞）

examples.en: My best friend is taller than me.
examples.zh: 我最好的朋友比我高。

examples.en: This test is easier than the last one.
examples.zh: 這次考試比上一次簡單。

examples.en: Her English is better than mine.
examples.zh: 她的英文比我的好。

examples.en: Science is more interesting than history to me.
examples.zh: 對我來說自然比歷史有趣。

quiz.q: My brother is ___ than my father now.
This book is ___ interesting than that one.

name: 形容詞最高級
zh: 三個以上比較，「最…的」用最高級，前面要加 the。短形容詞加 est，長形容詞加 the most。
points: tall → the tallest、big → the biggest、happy → the happiest
長形容詞：the most popular、the most important
不規則：good → the best、bad → the worst
in my class（在班上）/ of the three（三個之中）

examples.en: Amy is the tallest student in our class.
examples.zh: 艾咪是我們班最高的學生。

examples.en: This is the most popular club at school.
examples.zh: 這是學校最受歡迎的社團。

examples.en: Friday is the best day of the week.
examples.zh: 星期五是一週中最棒的一天。

examples.en: That was the worst movie of the year.
examples.zh: 那是年度最糟的電影。

quiz.q: Summer is ___ season of the year in Taiwan.
He is ___ popular singer in my country.

name: 頻率副詞（always / usually / sometimes / never）
pattern: 主詞 +（頻率副詞）+ 一般動詞 ／ be 動詞 + 頻率副詞
zh: 頻率副詞說明「多常做一件事」：always（總是）→ usually（通常）→ often（常常）→ sometimes（有時）→ never（從不）。位置在一般動詞前、be 動詞後。
points: I always check my phone after school.（一般動詞前）
She is never late.（be 動詞後）
How often do you play video games?（問頻率）
once a week（一週一次）/ twice a day（一天兩次）

examples.en: I usually watch videos after dinner.
examples.zh: 我通常在晚餐後看影片。

examples.en: He never plays computer games on school nights.
examples.zh: 上學日晚上他從不玩電腦遊戲。

examples.en: How often do you use the Internet? Every day.
examples.zh: 你多常上網？每天。

examples.en: She sometimes listens to music online.
examples.zh: 她有時會在線上聽音樂。

quiz.q: He ___ late for class. He is a good student.
___ do you play online games? Twice a week.

name: 連接詞 and / but / or / because / so
pattern: 句子 A + 連接詞 + 句子 B
zh: 連接詞把兩個想法接在一起：and（而且）、but（但是）、or（或者）、because（因為）、so（所以）。
points: and：I like music, and I like movies.
but：The phone is nice, but it is too expensive.
because + 原因：I stayed home because it rained.
so + 結果：It rained, so I stayed home.

examples.en: I finished my homework, so I can play games now.
examples.zh: 我寫完作業了，所以現在可以玩遊戲。

examples.en: She likes this app because it is easy to use.
examples.zh: 她喜歡這個 App，因為它很好用。

examples.en: Do you want to watch a movie or play video games?
examples.zh: 你想看電影還是打電動？

examples.en: The game is fun, but I only play on weekends.
examples.zh: 這遊戲很好玩，但我只在週末玩。

quiz.q: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
He can't buy the game ___ he doesn't have enough money.

name: 不定詞與動名詞（to V / V-ing）
pattern: like / love / enjoy + V-ing ／ want / hope + to V
zh: 有些動詞後面接 to + 原形（不定詞），有些接 V-ing（動名詞）。like / love 兩種都可以。
points: want / hope / decide + to V：I want to see pandas.
enjoy / finish / keep + V-ing：He enjoys hiking.
like / love / start：兩種都可以
V-ing 也能當主詞：Swimming is good exercise.

examples.en: I want to visit the zoo this weekend.
examples.zh: 這週末我想去動物園。

examples.en: She enjoys watching birds in the park.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在公園賞鳥。

examples.en: We decided to climb the mountain early.
examples.zh: 我們決定一早去爬山。

examples.en: Hiking in the forest makes me happy.
examples.zh: 在森林裡健行讓我很快樂。

quiz.q: My cat enjoys ___ by the window.
They hope ___ whales on the boat trip.

name: 介係詞（時間與地點）
pattern: in / on / at + 時間或地點
zh: 介係詞小小的卻很重要：at 用在時刻和小地點、on 用在日期和表面、in 用在月份年份和大空間。
points: 時間：at 7:00、on Monday / on July 4、in summer / in 2026
地點：at the bus stop、on the table、in the box / in Taipei
in front of（在…前面）、next to（在…旁邊）、under（在…下面）
between A and B（在 A 和 B 之間）

examples.en: The bird sings in the tree every morning.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥每天早上在樹上唱歌。

examples.en: We saw fireflies at night in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們晚上在山裡看到螢火蟲。

examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the chair.
examples.zh: 貓正睡在椅子下面。

examples.en: The park is next to the river.
examples.zh: 公園就在河的旁邊。

quiz.q: Many animals sleep ___ the day and hunt at night.
There is a bird's nest ___ the tall tree.

name: wh- 疑問句（What / Where / When / Who / Why / How）
pattern: 疑問詞 + be 動詞 / do / does / did + 主詞 ...？
zh: 想問「什麼、哪裡、何時、誰、為什麼、如何」就用 wh- 疑問詞開頭，後面接問句的語序。
points: What do you do on weekends?（問事情）
Where is the MRT station?（問地點）
When does the store open?（問時間）
Why / How：Why are you late? / How do you go to school?

examples.en: Where is the nearest convenience store?
examples.zh: 最近的便利商店在哪裡？

examples.en: When does the museum open on Sunday?
examples.zh: 博物館星期日幾點開門？

examples.en: How do you go to the city library?
examples.zh: 你怎麼去市立圖書館？

examples.en: Why do you like living in this city?
examples.zh: 你為什麼喜歡住在這個城市？

quiz.q: ___ does the bus leave? At nine thirty.
___ is your favorite place in the city? The park.

name: 現在完成式初探（have / has + p.p.）
pattern: 主詞 + have / has + 過去分詞（p.p.）
zh: 現在完成式表示「已經做過、曾經有過的經驗」。he / she / it 用 has，其他用 have。動詞要用過去分詞。
points: I have finished my homework.（已經完成）
She has visited Japan twice.（經驗，去過兩次）
常見 p.p.：see → seen、eat → eaten、be → been、do → done
ever / never：Have you ever seen snow? I have never seen it.

examples.en: I have finished all my summer homework.
examples.zh: 我已經完成所有暑假作業了。

examples.en: She has lived in this city for ten years.
examples.zh: 她已經在這個城市住了十年。

examples.en: Have you ever taken the high speed rail?
examples.zh: 你搭過高鐵嗎？

examples.en: We have never been to that new mall.
examples.zh: 我們從來沒去過那間新的購物中心。

quiz.q: I ___ already finished my report.
She has ___ to Japan three times.
